about.headline: Making sense of moving markets.
about.paragraph1: I'm a London-based financial market analyst, broadcast commentator and financial content creator covering global macroeconomics, foreign exchange, commodities and cross-asset markets.
about.paragraph2: I provide independent analysis for broadcasters and financial firms, while producing presenter-led videos, webinars, written commentary and educational content that makes complex markets understandable.
